findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation – "Give every custom control an accessible name…" lacks a specific data anchor from the audit.
Priority 2 recommendation – "Raise the contrast ratio of the flagged text…" is generic and not tied to any selector or page.
Priority 3 recommendation – "Make every id attribute unique within each page…" contains no specific ID, selector or page reference.
Priority 4 recommendation – "Add descriptive alt text to every informative image…" is a generic instruction without element context.
Priority 5 recommendation – "Expose the structure a sighted user sees…" does not name any specific table or cell selector.
Priority 6 recommendation – "Add a skip link as the first focusable element…" is a generic action with no page or selector.
Priority 7 recommendation – "Order headings without skipping levels…" lacks any specific heading level or page reference.
Priority 8 recommendation – "Replace obvious landmark containers (header, nav, main, footer, aside) with their semantic elements…" is generic and not tied to a particular element or page.
Priority 9 recommendation – "Profile the slow route with server‑side tooling…" does not specify which URL or path should be profiled.
Priority 10 recommendation – "Add the missing response headers at the server or CDN edge…" is a generic instruction without specifying which header values or pages to target.
Priority 11 recommendation – "Complete the flagged SEO metadata (title, meta description, canonical) so search engines and machines index the page…" lacks any specific page or element reference.
Priority 12 recommendation – "Add the missing required and recommended Schema.org properties to the flagged entity types…" is generic and not tied to a particular property or selector.
Priority 13 recommendation – "Add the missing required and recommended Schema.org properties to the flagged entity types…" (duplicate of 12) is also generic without specific data anchor.
